_RCMP_ are investigating the circumstances surrounding the "in custody" death Tuesday of a 67-year-old aboriginal man in Williams Lake.

The Williams Lake Indian band alleges that _Paul_ _Alphonse_ was the victim of excessive force by a patrol officer during an arrest April 11. _Alphonse_ was arrested after a complaint of an intoxicated man passed out in front of a store. Police say _Alphonse_ "became involved in an altercation with the arresting officer" while being booked into custody.

_Alphonse_ was taken by ambulance to hospital about 20 minutes after he complained of chest pains. He was returned to jail about 6:15 p.m. but was taken back to hospital about 4 1/2 hours later after again complaining of chest pains.
He remained in Cariboo Memorial Hospital until his death Tuesday night.
Prince George and Kamloops Mounties will assist in the probe.
